messages.author: bff58d77dc5c7cf4
messages.subject: passing attributes to the server
parts:
I have a newbie question about passing data from between ui and server.

At the start of the ui.R file, I generate a named list based on a query to a data base.
The named list consists of station numbers and their names. This is then used in
a selectInput() function and the selected station number is passed to server.R as input$station

In server.R another call to the data base is made, and the resulting data plotted.

When I wanted to make the figure caption I planned to use the station name associated with
input$station. In the original list this is stored as the attribute corresponding to the station number.

However I noticed that in server.R the attribute to input$station is lost, i.e  the variable input$station
only contains the the value, but not the attribute.

What is the simplest way to pass the attribute along with the station number?

Sincerely
Halldór


The relevant bit of shiny-R code is reproduced below:

in ui.R

# Make named station list
mylist=stationPairs(SQLquery("select station_number,station_name from TABLE where CONDITIONS"))

# Define UI
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
...
 
  # Sidebar for menus and sliders
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("station", "Station:",choices = mylist),
...
......some further items to select.
   
# in server.R
df=SQLquery(paste("select time",input$item, " from TABLE where stod=",input$station," where CONDITIONS")

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: passing attributes to the server
parts: I think the best way might be to have the "mylist=..." line not in ui.R, but in global.R; code in global.R will be executed before ui.R or server.R and will be available to both (i.e. in the global environment). Then in server.R you can look up the station name by indexing into the original list.
